title: Local Linearity of LLMs Enables Activation Steering via Model-Based Linear Optimal Control
reasoning: The paper focuses on a control-theoretic method (Activation-LQR) for steering LLM activations. While it evaluates its method using safety-oriented benchmarks such as toxicity reduction, truthfulness, and jailbreak prevention, it does not specifically investigate or benchmark religious beliefs, philosophical moral reasoning, or ethical frameworks as a primary component.
